ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image shows a central imine structure; after ignoring all curved arrows, it can be seen that the imine nitrogen is connected to a para-isopropylphenyl group; the imine carbon is connected to an upward methyl group, and is connected through a methylene group to a substituted cyclohexane. The connection site of this cyclohexane also bears an -NH-para-isopropylphenyl substituent, and another carbon on the ring also bears a methyl group. Both aromatic rings are para-isopropylphenyl groups. Then reason: according to the specified method, starting from the imine methyl side, encode as C/, the imine carbon is written as C(...)=N\...; the branch from the imine carbon to the cyclohexylmethyl substituent is CC1(Nc2ccc(C(C)C)cc2)CCCC(C)C1; the para-isopropylphenyl group connected to the imine nitrogen is c1ccc(C(C)C)cc1. Combine and retain the imine stereochemical slashes shown/specified in the diagram to obtain the SMILES: C/C(CC1(Nc2ccc(C(C)C)cc2)CCCC(C)C1)=N\c1ccc(C(C)C)cc1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a molecular graph while excluding all curved arrows. Encode from the imine methyl side: write the methyl attached to the imine carbon as `C/`, then the imine carbon as `C(...)=N\...`. Put the imine carbon branch to the cyclohexylmethyl substituent as `CC1(Nc2ccc(C(C)C)cc2)CCCC(C)C1`, because the first cyclohexane atom bears both the side chain and the anilino `N` substituent, and another ring carbon bears methyl. Encode each para-isopropylphenyl group as `c1ccc(C(C)C)cc1`, attaching one through `N` in the imine and the other through `N` in the NH substituent. Combine these parts with the indicated imine stereochemical slashes to obtain `C/C(CC1(Nc2ccc(C(C)C)cc2)CCCC(C)C1)=N\c1ccc(C(C)C)cc1`.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中显示一个中心亚胺结构，忽略所有弯曲箭头后，可见亚胺氮连接一个对异丙基苯基；亚胺碳连接一个向上的甲基，并通过一个亚甲基连接到取代环己烷。该环己烷的连接位点同时带有一个-NH-对异丙基苯基取代基，环上另一个碳还带有甲基。两个芳环均为对异丙基苯基。再推理：按指定方法从亚胺甲基侧开始编码为 C/，亚胺碳写作 C(...)=N\...；亚胺碳到环己基甲基取代基的分支为 CC1(Nc2ccc(C(C)C)cc2)CCCC(C)C1；亚胺氮连接的对异丙基苯基为 c1ccc(C(C)C)cc1。合并并保留图示/指定的亚胺立体斜线，得到 SMILES：C/C(CC1(Nc2ccc(C(C)C)cc2)CCCC(C)C1)=N\c1ccc(C(C)C)cc1。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-SMILES route: identify the molecular graph in the drawing, ignore only the curved reaction arrows, and encode the graph in one atom-walk. No alternative independent route is needed for this essentially single-answer task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn transition-state structure as a static molecule: an imine C=N linking an N-aryl para-isopropylphenyl group to a substituted imine carbon; that imine carbon also bears a methyl group and a methylene chain to a cyclohexane ring. The cyclohexane ring has a methyl substituent and a ring carbon bearing an NH-aryl substituent, where the aryl group is another para-isopropylphenyl ring. Curved arrows in the image are ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to know that the required output is a SMILES expression and that the curved arrows in the transition-state drawing must be ignored rather than encoded.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: lowercase aromatic atoms for benzene rings, branches in parentheses for isopropyl and amino substituents, numeric ring closures for the cyclohexane ring, implicit hydrogens for NH as `N`, and slash/backslash notation to preserve the depicted imine alkene-like geometry.
